issues.description: Everything for the new checkout and the emails that follow an order.

issues.summary: Add a 'Download receipt' link to order emails
issues.description:
Customers keep writing in to ask for a receipt. Put a link to it in the order confirmation email.

Done when:
- The order confirmation email has a 'Download receipt' link under the order total.
- The link opens the receipt PDF for that order.
- An order with no receipt yet shows no link.
- The plain-text version of the email has the link too.

comments.author: u-ann
comments.body: Receipts are PDFs from the billing service. Their links expire after 30 days, so the email should link to our own /orders/:id/receipt page, which makes a fresh one.

comments.author: u-raj
comments.body: The template is templates/emails/order_confirmation.html, with order_confirmation.txt next to it.

issues.description:
Shop managers need to download last month's orders for their accountant.

Done when:
- A 'Download orders' button on the Orders page exports the selected month as CSV.
- The file has one row per order: date, order number, customer, total, tax.
- It works for a month with no orders (header row only).

comments.author: u-mo
comments.body: Accounting asked for this before the 15th if possible.

pages.title: Orders export
pages.body:
Orders export

Shop managers export a month of orders for their accountant.

Format

The export is an XLSX workbook, one sheet per month, because the accountant's tool can't read CSV with our date format.

  • Columns: date, order number, customer, total, tax, currency
  • Dates as YYYY-MM-DD

pages.title: Order emails
pages.body:
Order emails

Every order sends a confirmation email from templates/emails/. Each HTML template has a plain-text twin.

Links in emails must go to our own domain, never to the billing service.
